project_name: Youanmi Gold Project hybrid power station (BOO)
location: Youanmi, Mid West, Western Australia (~150 km SW of Mount Magnet)
selection_note: Hindsight-selected development case (not a sealed holdout), taken from an unverified lead (Pacific Energy 10-year PPA). Very recent, so the whole chain (DFS, IPP engagement, power tender, FID, PPA) sits within roughly 9 months. The only early signal is in the same release as the earliest procurement-type event, and the PPA date is a trade-press printed date, so no lead time is stated.

DFS confirms high-grade, high-margin gold production at Youanmi

**Underground project to produce an average 117,000 oz/pa over an initial 7-year mine life at

target.title: DFS: Rox engaged multiple IPPs to provide options for a site hybrid BOO power station; engagement intended to lead to a power supply contract, initial pricing provided for the Study

availability_evidence.note: Same ASX release as s1 (13/11/2025 8:40 am Sydney time, AEDT +11:00, idsId=03024845). Agent-asserted from an ASX listing retrieved by curl and not captured.

target.source_quote:
Rox engaged multiple Independent Power Providers (IPP) to provide options for a site hybrid 
power station under a Build Own Operate (BOO) model. This engagement is intended to lead to 
a power supply contract, however initial pricing was provided to inform appropriate pricing for 
the Study. In parallel to the power supply, EVOL LNG were engaged to provide an LNG supply 
solution, where LNG would be supplied from the Mid-West LNG Plant and stored on-site at 
Youanmi.
target.target_description: In the DFS release, Rox says it engaged multiple IPPs for options for a site hybrid BOO power station, intended to lead to a power supply contract, with initial IPP pricing used to inform the Study. This is the earliest procurement-type event found (proposal solicitation / market sounding); it is in the SAME ASX release as the DFS (s1), so the measured lead time is about zero. Later tender-stage items and the PPA are in later_procurement_events.
